principle: Motion explains causality, is interruptible, and preserves meaning under reduced motion. The meaning layer under `portable` is authoritative and travels to every target. Every number under `targets` is target-local expression: it is deliberately NOT promoted to core/TOKENS.json, for the same reason fixture viewports are not breakpoints.

laws.statement: Motion must express a cause the viewer can name. If you cannot say what moved and why, the motion is decoration and must be removed.
laws.test: State the cause in one sentence for each animated element. 'It looks alive' is not a cause.

laws.statement: Motion performs a function: it carries, reveals, directs, confirms, or retires. It does not idle.
laws.test: No animated element may loop, breathe, pulse, float or oscillate on a cycle that is not tied to a state change.

laws.statement: The exit vector of one moment determines the entry vector of the next. Two independently animated segments read as two videos, not one film.
laws.test: For each seam, name the outgoing vector and the incoming vector. They must be the same vector.

laws.statement: A state change cancels superseded motion. Motion never queues behind a state it no longer describes.
laws.test: Reverse or supersede a transition mid-flight; the projected state must match the newest intent, not the oldest animation.

laws.statement: Removing non-essential duration must preserve reading order, state meaning, action meaning and accessible names. Reduced motion is a different projection of the same meaning, not a degraded one.
laws.test: Render the reduced variant and confirm the same information is present in the same order.

laws.statement: Stillness immediately before the most important frame increases that frame. Sustained motion everywhere means nothing arrives.
laws.test: Each sequence has at least one held beat before its climax.

prohibitions.statement: No idle wobble, breathing, levitation, pulse or idle rotation on an element with no state change behind it.

No motion may be applied to a ratified identity master. Perspective transforms, re-lighting and per-pixel recolouring of the artwork are prohibited outright; a mark is a still thing and the frame moves around it.
State meaning may never be carried by animation alone. If the motion is removed, the state must still be legible as text.
A target's duration ladder must not be promoted into core/TOKENS.json or described as a global duration scale.

roles.meaning: Content becomes visible for the first time.
roles.reduced_motion_equivalent: Content is present from the first frame; no transform, no fade.
Content is present at its final position from the first frame.

roles.meaning: A request is in flight and has not been observed. This is explicitly not success.
roles.reduced_motion_equivalent: Pending text is shown statically. No spinner, sweep or loop of any kind.

roles.meaning: An authoritative observation has reported a result.
roles.reduced_motion_equivalent: The observed text replaces the pending text with no transition.

roles.meaning: A condition requires inspection and the viewer should look at it.
roles.reduced_motion_equivalent: The non-colour cue and the text carry it; no motion is added.

roles.meaning: The viewpoint moves to a new subject.
roles.reduced_motion_equivalent: A hard cut. The new subject is present at full scale on the first frame of the new segment.

roles.meaning: Content leaves because it is no longer the subject.
roles.reduced_motion_equivalent: Content is absent from the first frame of the next segment.

seams.intent: Advance to a new subject while preserving the outgoing motion's screen direction.
seams.reduced_motion_equivalent: Hard cut at the same frame boundary.

seams.intent: Push through the current subject into the next, with scale increasing across the seam.
Pull back out of the current subject into the next, with scale decreasing across the seam.
A held frame interrupts the flow, then motion resumes on the same vector.
seams.reduced_motion_equivalent: The held beat is retained; only the transitions are removed.

seams.intent: Hold position and move attention by changing sharpness, with no displacement.
seams.reduced_motion_equivalent: Both elements render sharp; the focus cue is carried by the non-colour indicator and text.

seams.intent: Staggered arrival of a group, ordered by element weight, so the group assembles rather than appearing.
seams.reduced_motion_equivalent: The whole group is present on the first frame, in its final arrangement.

seams.intent: Slow-fast-slow repositioning of a group; a reposition, not an attention grab.
seams.reduced_motion_equivalent: The group is present at its final position from the first frame.

state_timing.statement: A pending projection must remain pending until an observation reports a result, regardless of any motion schedule. Motion may express the wait; it may not resolve it.

remotion.note: Target-local expression. These are frame counts at this target's frame rate, not global tokens, and must not be copied into core/TOKENS.json.
remotion.ladder_note: Step names are motion vocabulary and must not reuse a colour-ramp or spacing step name. An earlier draft called the middle step 'base', which collided with the ratified signalOrange/royalBlue/beretGreen 'base' step and made a token leak ambiguous to detect.

velocity_match.statement: A velocity-matched seam travels roughly 12% of the frame dimension on each side of the cut, so the two segments share screen velocity at the boundary.

blur_scale_px_at_1080p.statement: Blur is scaled by element size, not applied globally.

reduced_motion.detection: The renderer is headless and reports the render machine's motion preference, which is not the viewer's. A target MUST therefore expose reduced motion as an explicit input as well as honouring the platform preference where one is available.
